archetypes.name: dyn-oos-reentry
archetypes.rationale: Review OOS sink preservation is stateful and re-entry-sensitive.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the review_tally emit path and review_core_body coverage for same-run re-entry. Verify a promoted oos-accepted-review.md cannot be destructively rebuilt from a lingering round oos.md, while partial sinks still fail closed. Check parent-session copy behavior remains intact. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
